3f8e1d4f: ;
 .;Set the status of the Discharge Summary based on the values in the record.
 .;The possible status values are:
 .;- INCOMPLETE (if no dictation date)
 .;- DICTATED (if dictation date but no transcription date)
 .;- TRANSCRIBED (if transcription date but no signature)
 .;- SIGNED NO REVIEW (if signature but no review required)
 .;- SIGNED (if signature and review required but no review date)
 .;- REVIEWED (if signature, review required, and review date)
2f3784a3: ;Initialize variables to store the status and node values.
7450ebc8: ;Get the Discharge Summary Date node from the record.
1d2a3221: ;If no dictation date, set status to INCOMPLETE.
d443207a: ;If dictation date but no transcription date, set status to DICTATED.
75942ac9: ;If transcription date but no signature, set status to TRANSCRIBED.
dac04369: ;If signature and no review required, set status to SIGNED NO REVIEW.
ff7f009a: ;If signature and review required but no review date, set status to SIGNED.
08ce7333: ;If signature, review required, and review date, set status to REVIEWED.
8d04382e: ;Update the status field in the record with the new status value.
59b8510d: ;Exit the STAT1 subroutine.
